description: Evaluation corpus for the Bedrock Guardrail in infrastructure/cloudformation/04-bedrock-guardrails.yaml. Each row is evaluated with ApplyGuardrail as user INPUT or model OUTPUT. effect: pass (no intervention), block (whole text replaced by the blocked message), anonymize (text returned with masked values), detect (assessed but not blocked). policies: the policies that must appear in the assessment (topic:<name>, content:<type>, pii:<type>, regex:<name>); empty for rows that may pass. entity: the anonymize-type entity a row exercises, on input (where it is passed unmasked) or output (where it is masked). All identifiers and credentials are synthetic or AWS documentation examples. A row may list several acceptable effects in 'effects' when the topic classifier can vary without changing the outcome (for example detect or pass, both of which return the answer unchanged).

    Type: AWS::GameLift::ContainerFleet

      FleetRoleArn: !GetAtt FleetRole.Arn
      InstanceType: c6i.large
